description: This file defines the IQueueAdapter interface for a streaming queue storage adapter in Orleans, including methods for writing message batches, creating receivers, and properties for stream direction and reusability. It also includes extension methods for simplified message queuing.

classes.name: IQueueAdapter
classes.description: Interface that abstracts the underlying queue storage system with methods for message batching, receiver creation, and properties indicating stream capabilities.

classes.name: QueueAdapterExtensions
classes.description: Static class providing extension methods for IQueueAdapter, including a convenient method to queue a single message.

methods.name: QueueMessageBatchAsync
methods.description: Queues a batch of events as a single message to the specified stream.

methods.name: CreateReceiver
methods.description: Creates a queue receiver for a specified queue ID.

methods.name: QueueMessageAsync
methods.description: Extension method to queue a single event message using QueueMessageBatchAsync under the hood.
